description: Kafr Hatif  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 1   Fortification Askar    Kafr Hatif is a village in the 1 Sultanate ruled by the emir Iyalas of the Banu Arbas. The village is bound to Askar and is known to produce Desert Horses.

name: Mahloul
description: Mahloul sits in a broad valley between the Jarjara Escarpment and the Jabal Ashabi Mountains in the desert steppe southeast of the Bahr al-Yeshm. Groundwater provides just enough water to grow crops for subsistence, while the village makes its money from rearing horses on the rich grass that grows in the Jabal Ashabi after the spring rains.[1]

name: Liwas
description: Liwas sits in a broad valley south of the Bahr al-Yeshm. Farmland is limited here, and the land is best known for the horses that are grazed on the desert's short-lived but rich spring grasses.[1]

name: Waltas
description: Waltas sits by the Bahr al-Yeshm, the Jade Sea, in lowlands well suited to the growing of flax.[1]

name: Abu Khih
description: Abu Khih sits along the Nahr al-Kals River on its way to its barren southern reaches. The surrounding lands, an ancient lakebed, are already becoming barren and alkaline, although date-palms still thrive.[1]

name: Hoqqa
description: Hoqqa sits on the far east of the 1 lands, on the Tyagis River. The land is mostly desert-steppe. Barren most of the year except for scrub, it is covered in grass and flowers in the spring and is fine grazing for horses.[1]

name: Abba
description: Abba sits on the edge of the deep desert, at the foot of the landward side of the Jarjara Escarpment. Runoff from the hills is trapped underground here, creating springs that sustain an oasis. Wheat thrives in the fields and gardens.[1]

name: Bir Seif
description: Bir Seif is centered around a group of wells and pools in the Jarjara Escarpment. Villagers dig down to the shallow groundwater layer for clay to sell to the potters of the Nahasa Desert. [1]

name: Ezbet Nahul
description: Ezbet Nahul  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 1   Fortification Qasira    Ezbet Nahul is a village in the 1 Sultanate ruled by the emir Talas of the Banu Atij. The village is bound to Qasira and is known to produce Grain.

name: Abghan
description: Abghan  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 1   Fortification Qasira    Abghan is a village in the 1 Sultanate ruled by the emir Talas of the Banu Atij. The village is bound to Qasira and is known to produce Fish.

name: Tasheba
description: Tasheba lies on the western edges of the Bahr al-Yeshm. Fishermen venture out into the protected waters, gentle and calm for most of the year, for tuna and sardines.[1]

name: Baq
description: Baq slightly inland from the Bahr al-Yeshm sea, beneath the great granite outcrop of the Jabal Tamar Mountains. The seawinds bring the uplands here just enough rain to support the cultivation of olive trees.[1]

name: Hiblet
description: Hiblet sits at the base of the granite outcrop known as the Jabal Tamar Mountains. Rainwater trapped in cracks in the rock is diverted to the village's date-palm gardens.[1]

name: Mussum
description: Mussum sits near the eastern coast of the Bahr al-Yeshm sea, where the 1 deserts give way to desert-steppe with scattered acacia and scrub. The villagers here sink wells to water their groves of date palms.[1]

name: Qablab
description: Qablab sits near a broad bay on the southern coast of the Perassic Sea. The low-lying coastline is well-suited to the construction of salt pans.[1]

name: Doqa
description: Doqa is a fishing village on the Bahr al-Yeshm sea. Villagers sail out in feluccas to harvest perch that sometimes grow as long as a man is tall, keeping an eye out for the salt-water crocodiles which live in the local inlets and marshes and which compete with them for their catch.[1]

name: Mijayit
description: Mijayit lies off of the estuary of the Damar River as it reaches the Bahr al-Yeshm sea. The rich silt deposits left by the river make this one of the most fertile regions of the 1 lands. [1]

name: Hamoshawat
description: Hamoshawat lies on the lower Damar River, just before it reaches the Bahr al-Yeshm sea. The rich silt deposits left by the river make this one of the most fertile regions of the 1 lands. [1]

name: Jahasim
description: Jahasim sits on the southern shore of the sea that the 1 call the Bahr al-Yeshm. The warm waters abound in tuna, bonito, sardines, and other fish. [1]

name: Nahlan
description: Nahlan sits on the floodplain of the Damar River as it cuts through the Jarjara Escarpment. This soil, refreshed yearly by the silt of the flooding river, produces bountiful crops of wheat. [1]

description: Glenlithrig  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Dunglanys    Glenlithrig is a village of 2 owned by the chieftain Ergeon of the Clan fen Derngil. The village is bound to Dunglanys and known to produce Hardwood.

description: Beglomuar  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Marunath    Beglomuar is a village in 2 owned by High King Caladog of clan fen Gruffendoc. The village is bound to Marunath and known to produce Iron Ore.

name: Dalmengus
description: Dalmengus sits by the side of the Llyn Tywal, the Dark Lake at the center of the Uchalion massif. The flat, well-watered lands here are fertile and well-suited to wheat and barley.[1]

name: Ebereth
description: Ebereth  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Marunath    Ebereth is a village in 2 owned by High King Caladog of clan fen Gruffendoc. The village is bound to Marunath and known to produce Hardwood.

description: Gainseth  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2    Gainseth is a village in 2 owned by the chieftain Aeron of Clan fen Giall. The village is bound to Pen Cannoc and known to produce Clay.

description: Bryn Glas  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Seonon    Bryn Glas is a village in 2 owned by the chieftain Luichan of Clan fen Penraic. The village is bound to Seonon and known to produce Iron Ore.

description: Mag Arba       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Seonon    Mag Arba is a village in 2 owned by Mormaer Luichan of clan fen Penraic. The village is bound to Seonon and known to produce Clay.

name: Swenryn
description: Swenryn  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Seonon    Swenryn is a village in 2 owned by the chieftain Luichan of Clan fen Penraic. The village is bound to Seonon and known to produce Horses, specifically 2n Ponies.

name: Karakalat
description: Karakalat lies in a basin in the flat, eastern edges of the Devseg plateau. Until recently, this land was dominated by nomads, and it is still famous as a breeding ground for horses.

name: Tismil
description: Tismil sits on the Ozu river, which drains the southern end of the Devseg plateau. The people of this land are sheep-herders, who have thrived under 4 overlordship as the khans keep nomadic raiders at bay.[1]

name: Fisnar
description: Fisnar sits alongside the Zakhan, a tributary of the Karakaz river. Though this valley is snowbound for much of the year, the spring grasses nonetheless sustain sizeable herds of sheep, the thick wool of which protects them from this land's icy winds.

name: Ulaan
description: Ulaan sits in the valley of the Karakaz river. The villagers, nomads who have recently been forced by the khans to settle, have learned to grow flax in this low-lying marshy land.

name: Asalig
description: Asalig sits at the foot of Bars Dag, one of the peaks that marks the edge of the Devseg plateau. Villagers raise horses in the lower slopes, keeping watch for the snow leopards for which the peak is named.[1]

name: Okhutan
description: Okhutan is a village at the center of a wheat-growing district on a narrow stretch of plain between the Akkan hills and Lake Tanaesis, which the 4 call the Tanaz Sea.

name: Ispantar
description: Ispantar is a village on a rocky spur of the Akkan hills overlooking Lake Tanaesis, which the 4 call the Tanaz Sea. The villagers here make most of their income from the raising of sheep.

name: Pabastan
description: Pabastan sits in the narrow plain between the Akkan hills and Lake Tanaesis, which the 4 call the Tanaz Sea. This land is fine country for wheat.

name: Shapeshte
description: Shapeshte sits where the waters of the Zakhan River meet the Karakaz. The village makes its living from mining nearby salt deposits.[1]

name: Hanekhy
description: Hanekhy sits atop a northern spur of the Akkan Hills. The reddish streaks in the soil and rocks testify to rich iron deposits, which are mined by the villagers.[1]

name: Mazen
description: The fishing village of Mazen sits on the northern end of Lake Tanaesis, which the 4 call the Tanaz Sea. The villagers set nets in the nearby Karakaz River to catch a variety of fish migrating to and from the lake.[1]

name: Danara
description: Danara sits by the salt lake that the 4 know as Tsanga Nor, the pool that quenches no thirst. The villagers of these parts extract salt from the bitter waters.

name: Ransam
description: Ransam is in the southeastern plains of the Devseg plateau. Villagers, who not long ago still lived a nomadic lifestyle, specialize in the rearing of horses.

name: Mivanjan
description: Mivanjan sits at the foot of the Sulun Dag mountains, that mark the eastern border of the Devseg plateau. Villagers, who not long ago still lived a nomadic lifestyle, raise sheep in the foothills.

name: Urunjan
description: Urunjan near the western edge of the Devseg plateau, at the foot of the Akkan hills. Villagers raise cattle here that are bred to withstand both the hot summers and freezing winters.

name: Marabrot
description: Marabrot sits on a high rocky ridge between the fjord known as Mazopor Bay and the Byalic Sea. This harsh land would probably not be settled where it not for the rich iron deposits in the hills.[1]

name: Safna
description: Safna sits on a high ridge overlooking the rapids that link Lake Laconis to the narrow Mazopor Bay. Villagers rear cattle on the grassy shelfs overlooking the sea-cliffs.[1]

name: Chornobas
description: Chornobas, or Blackwood, sits in lands cleared from the forests overlooking the cataract through which the Miron River empties into Lake Laconis. The villagers grow rye and barley in fields misted by the spray from the falls.[1]

name: Skorin
description: Skorin sits on a promontory separating Dyatom Bay from the wider Lake Laconis. Villagers pull both freshwater flatfish from the shallow bay waters and bigger catch, including pike, from the main lake.[1]

name: Korsyas
description: Korsyas sits near the narrowest part of the Bay of Varcheg. Villagers fish the waters to the west for cod, char, and other cold-water sea fish that venture into the bay.[1]

name: Karbur
description: Karbur sits at a plateau on the Kachyar Peninsula. Sheltered somewhat by a high ridge to their north, the villagers here raise barley and grain.[1]

name: Alebat
description: Alebat sits deep in the forests of northeastern 6. This isolated region has long been a refuge for those fleeing oppression or debt or bloodfeud across the northlands, and the dialect is strongly influenced by the tongue of the Vanni woodspeople.[1]

name: Radakmed
description: Radakmed sits in a basin amid the Chertyg Mountains. Villagers here grow flax in the marshy valley floor.[1]

name: Kvol
description: The villagers of Kvol raise small, sturdy cattle at the base of the Chertyg Mountains. They include the descendants of refugees and malcontents from across Calradia, seeking isolation in the cold northern forests.[1]

name: Bukits
description: Bukits sits on the eastern slopes of Mount Iltan on the 4 frontier. Villagers raise highland cattle here, bred to withstand the icy gusts that tear down the mountain.[1]

name: Visibrot
description: Visibrot is a sheep-rearing village on the lower slopes of Mount Iltan, just below the network of glacial lakes known as the Portages of Iltan. Though this region is cold and remote, its importance as a trade juncture between Lake Laconis and Lake Tanaesis, between the Empire and the steppe, means that it is relatively densely populated.[1]

name: Kargrev
description: Kargrev was once 'Car Gryff', the ringfort of the 2n chief Gryff, but was conquered by the 6ns two generations ago. It lies alongside the Bay of Varcheg, where the local fishermen take advantage of the relatively sheltered waters of the bay, where fish of many kinds come to spawn.[1]

name: Rodobas
description: Rodobas, meaning 'the house of Obas', is named for a long-dead 6n hill chieftain. Perched high on a ridge overlooking the Ircara Wildlands, it serves as a base for trappers looking for furs in the dark woods below.[1]

name: Yangutum
description: Yangutum sits in a nook of the Chertyg Mountains on the north shores of Lake Laconis. Villagers here have found iron ore deposits in the mountainsides.[1]

name: Omkany
description: Omkany lies where the Lake Laconis coastline rises up to meet the icy Chertyg Mountains. Villagers in this district raise hogs, curing their fat with salt and in garlic and selling it throughout the northlands.[1]

name: Borchovagorka
description: Borchovagorka sits on a small rise on the steep northern shores of Lake Laconis. The village depends primarily on fishing, pulling perch, bream, salmon and occasionally large sturgeon and pike from the lake waters. [1]

description: Fregian  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Ocs Hall    Fregian is a village in 7 owned by the baron, Belgir of the House dey Fortes. The village is bound to Ocs Hall and is known to produce Flax.

name: Horsger
description: Horsger is where, according to legend, the warrior Horsa came ashore and planted his spear in the beach. Today it is known for its daring fishermen, who venture out far to find banks, chilled by currents from the north, that are rich in cod.

name: Cananc
description: Cananc lies in the wet wooded hills of the northern Rhennod, where cedars grow tall in the sea-mists. The villagers trap beaver, marten and rabbit for their pelts.

name: Remental
description: Remental sits in a gap in the mountains of the Ebor peninsula. Towering fir and spruce grow on the slopes. Villagers trap fur-bearing animals like marten, rabbit and fox. This wild region has recently attracted many settlers drawn to the relative freedom of the woods, where the rule of the 7n barons is much lighter than in the south.

name: Alantas
description: Alantas sits in the center of the mountainous Ebor peninsula. The soil here is thin and the weather here is cold, but rich iron deposits sustain the local economy.[1]

name: Halisvust
description: Halisvust  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Rovalt    Halisvust is a village of 7 owned by the baron, Servic of House dey Valant. The village is bound to Rovalt and it is known to produce Grain.

description: Etirburg  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Sargot    Etirfurd is a village in 7 owned by King Derthert of House dey Meroc. The village is bound to Sargot and is known to produce Grain.

name: Avasinton
description: Avasinton  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Amprela    Avasinton is a village of the Northern Empire owned by Encurion of the Impestores clan. The village is bound to Amprela and it is known to produce Cotton.

name: Boreagora
description: Boreagora lies in the cold north of the Empire, by the network of glacial lakes known as the Portages of Iltan. Nearby imperial forts, looming over the waterways, keep watch for 6n and 4 raiders. The lowlands here are suited to the growing of flax.[1]

name: Alatys
description: Alatys  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Argoros    Alatys is a village in the Northern Empire owned by Emperor Lucon of clan Osticos. The village is bound to Argoros and is known to produce Fish.

name: Hetania
description: Hetania  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Argoros    Hetania is a village in the Northern Empire owned by Emperor Lucon of clan Osticos. The village is bound to Argoros and is known to produce Hardwood.

name: Alosea
description: Alosea lies near the entrance of the Diathmic Bay, on the far western end of Lake Laconis. The folk of this region live well off the pike and sturgeon of the lake.[1]

name: Jeracos
description: Jeracos sits in meadowland in the northern piedmont of the Dryatic mountains. The climate, kept mild by the lake breezes, makes for good horse breeding.[1]

name: Gymos
description: Gymos is a quiet fishing village in the Diathmic Bay, on the far west of Lake Laconis. Villagers harvest pike from the bay's deep waters.[1]

name: Marathea
description: Marathea lies on a narrow shelf of land between the Miron River and Mount Aracathos, the tallest peak in the Dryatic Mountains. The villagers are skilled miners, extracting iron ores from the nearby cliffside.[1]

name: Stathymos
description: Stathymos lies in a narrow valley beneath a towering ridge of the Dryatic Mountains. The highland streams wash fertile soil down the hillsides, making this district one of the breadbaskets of the imperial north.[1]

name: Orthra
description: Orthra  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Myzea    Orthra is a village of the Northern Empire owned by the archon Gyphor of the Dolentos clan. The village is bound to Myzea and is known to produce Horses.

name: Samatha
description: Samatha sits upon a sloping ridge in the sun-drenched highlands of the Myzead. The hillsides have been terraced to allow the growing of mulberry bushes. The leaves are harvested, placed in vats and fed to silkworms.[1]

name: Vealos
description: Vealos  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Myzea    Vealos is a village of the Northern Empire owned by the archon Gyphor of the Dolentos clan. The village is bound to Myzea and is known to produce Horses.

name: Crios
description: Crios  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Saneopa    Crios is a village of the Northern Empire owned by the archon Penton of the Neretzes clan. The village is bound to Saneopa and known to produce Horses.

name: Enoisa
description: Enoisa  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Saneopa    Enoisa is a village of the Northern Empire owned by the archon Penton of the Neretzes clan. The village is bound to Saneopa and known to produce Grain.

name: Ain Baliq
description: Ain Baliq is clustered around a well in a wide valley that separates the Jarjara Escarpment from the Jabal Tamar Mountains to the west. The surrounding lands, though dry, produce enough grass in the spring to allow the breeding of horses.[1]

name: Deir Hawa
description: Deir Hawa sits on the windswept southern shores of the sea that the 1 call the Bahr al-Yeshm. Villagers trap run-off water from the hills and grow flax in the lowlands here.[1]

name: Barihal
description: The oasis-village of Barihal sits in a wadi amid the mesas of the Jarjara Escarpment. The land is best known for the horses that are grazed on the desert's short-lived but rich spring grasses.[1]

name: Wadar
description: Wadar sits in the rocky wadis at the inland edge of the Jarjara Escarpment, before it gives way to barren gravel plains and dunes. Clouds from the Bahr al-Yeshm drop their last reserves of water here in the spring and winter, giving the land just enough grass to support horse-rearing.[1]

name: Jamayeh
description: Jamayeh sits on the southern shores of the sea that the 1 call the Bahr al Yeshm, the Jade Sea. The climate is well-suited to olive trees that thrive despite the short rainy season. [1]

name: Hunab
description: Hunab  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 1   Fortification Jamayeh Castle    Hunab is a village in the 1 Sultanate ruled by the emir Suruq of the Banu Qaraz. The village is bound to Jamayeh Castle and is known to produce Dates.

name: Medeni
description: Medeni sits in lowlands between the Bahr al-Yeshm sea and the Jarjara Escarpment. Villagers grow dates by the coast in gardens watered by wells and small dams in the wadis that trap run-off from the cliffs during the short rainy season. [1]

name: Qidnar
description: Qidnar lies in the floodplain of the Damar River, the most densely populated part of the 1 lands, where it slices through the Jarjara Escarpment. Farmers here grow grain in the rich silt brought by the river's annual flooding. [1]

name: Sahel
description: Sahel       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 1   Fortification Sahel Castle    Sahel is a village of the 1 owned by Emir Tais of the Banu Qild. The village is bound to Sahel Castle and known to produce Grain.

name: Asmait
description: Asmait lies in a nook of the Jabal Ashabi Mountains, bordered to the south by the deep desert. Villagers trap floods running down the hills during rare rainstorms, using the water to grow date palms and other crops.[1]

name: Shibal Zumr
description: Shibal Zumr sits on the Nahr al-Kals, the river of lime. Here the waters are pure and the soil is fertile, and grain is grown. But a short distance to the south, the land becomes barren and alkaline, and only the hardiest crops survive.[1]

name: Lamesa
description: Lamesa sits amid open plains and patches of dry acacia forest on the eastern shores of the Bahr al-Yeshm. Some of the 1's most prized horses graze on the grasses of this district.[1]

name: Tamnuh
description: Tamnuh sits near a large lagoon, cut off from the Perassic Sea by a sandspit. Villagers scrape clay from the shallow waters to sell to the region's potters.[1]

name: Kuqa
description: Kuqa sits at the foot of a range of low hills east of the Bahr al-Yeshm sea, where the 1 deserts give way to desert-steppe with scattered acacia and scrub. The villagers here sink wells to water their groves of date palms.[1]

name: Fanab
description: Fanab sits in a low promontory between the bay that the 1 call the Gulf of Shiraz and the inner sea of the Bahr al-Yeshm.  The seawinds bring just enough rain to support the cultivation of olive trees.[1]

name: Tubilis
description: Tubilis lies on the Gulf of Charas, which the 1 call the Gulf of Shariz. Villagers go fishing here amid the offshore islands in search of tuna, sardines, and shark.[1]

name: Uqba
description: Uqba sits alongside the Perassic Sea. Villagers trap rainwater and runoff from the hills to water their fields and their gardens of date-palms.[1]

name: Bunqaz
description: Bunqaz sits at the mouth of the great wadi that divides the Jarjara Escarpment from the Jabal Tamar Mountains. Villagers sink wells here to tap the wadi's groundwater, using it to irrigate their olive groves.[1]

name: Ab Comer
description: Ab Comer       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Ab Comer Castle    Ab Comer is a village in 2 owned by Mormaer Maireas of clan fen Caernacht. The village is bound to Ab Comer Castle and known to produce Grapes.

name: Inveth
description: Inveth       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Ab Comer Castle    Inveth is a village in 2 owned by Mormaer Maireas of clan fen Caernacht. The village is bound to Ab Comer Castle and known to produce Grain.

description: Aster  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Aster Castle    Aster is a village within the lands of 2 owned by the chieftain Ergeon of Clan fen Derngil. The village is bound to Aster Castle and known to produce Flax.

name: Imlagh
description: Imlagh  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Aster Castle    Imlagh is a village within the lands of 2 owned by the chieftain Ergeon of Clan fen Derngil. The village is bound to Aster Castle and known to produce Grapes.

name: Druimmor
description: Druimmor  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Druimmor Castle    Druimmor is a village of 2 owned by the chieftain Aradwyr of the Clan fen Eingal.  The village is bound to Druimmor Castle and is known to produce Silver Ore.

name: Tor Melina
description: Tor Melina  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Druimmor Castle    Tor Melina is a village of 2 owned by the chieftain Aradwyr of clan fen Eingal. The village is bound to Druimmor Castle and is known to produce Cotton.

name: Flintolg
description: Flintolg  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Flintolg Castle    Flintolg is a village within the lands of 2 owned by the chieftain Luichan of Clan fen Penraic. The village is bound to Flintolg Castle and it is known to produce Hardwood.

name: Glintor
description: Glintor sits overlooking the rapids of the Fiur river, where the waters of Llyn Tywal descend to enter the Bay of Varcheg. Horses are raised on the downs, much prized by both raiders and traders from the 6n lands to the north.

name: Llanoc Hen
description: Llanoc Hen sits in a ridge in the heights of the Uchalion massif. The villagers, known as skilled pig-farmers, look down two passes, the western one leading up from 7n lands and the eastern one leading up from the Empire.[1]

name: Cantrec
description: Cantrec sits in the rocky Glen of Balasog that climbs up from the imperial lands into the plateau of the Uchalion. The lands is not especially fertile here, but pigs thrive in the bush and shrubland of the heights.[1]

name: Pendraic
description: DANK OHIO Pendraic sits on the steep northern slope of the Uchalion Plateau, facing the Bay of Varcheg. It is a land of cold winds and constant low-level warfare, criss-crossed by 7n, 2n and 6n raiding parties. The villagers raise hogs here, always listening to the warning horns telling them to drive their herds to hiding spots in the hills.[1]

name: Lindorn
description: Lindorn sits on the green hills north and west of Llyn Tywal, the dark lake. The surrounding farmlands are sown with wheat and barley.[1]

name: Rhemtoil
description: Rhemtoil  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2    Rhemtoil is a village in 2 owned by High King Caladog of clan fen Gruffendoc. The village is bound to Rhemtoil Castle and known to produce Grain.

name: Claig Ban
description: Claig Ban  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Rhemtoil Castle    Claig Ban is a village in 2 owned by High King Caladog of clan fen Gruffendoc. The village is bound to Rhemtoil Castle and known to produce Clay.

name: Uthelaim
description: Uthelaim  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Uthelaim Castle    Uthelaim is a village in 2 owned by High King Caladog of clan fen Gruffendoc. The village is bound to Uthelaim Castle and known to produce Hardwood.

name: Seordas
description: Seordas  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 2   Fortification Uthelaim Castle    Seordas is a village in 2 owned by High King Caladog of clan fen Gruffendoc. The village is bound to Uthelaim Castle and known to produce Grain.

name: Akiser
description: Akiser sits in the southern reaches of the Akkan hills. The land here is exceptionally broken and weathered, revealing seams of iron in the sides of the gullies and ravines.

name: Dinar
description: Dinar lies in the far north of the 4 confederacy, along the Karakaz river. Snow-bound for much of the year, the spring grasses nonetheless sustain sizeable herds of sheep, the thick wool of which protects them from this land's icy winds.

name: Karahalli
description: Karahalli lies in the far north of the 4 confederacy, not far from the icy Byalic Sea. Snow-bound for much of the year, the spring grasses nonetheless sustain sizeable herds of sheep, the thick wool of which protects them from the icy winds blowing off of the waters.

name: Erzenur
description: Erzenur alongside the River Tiagys, known in the local dialect as the 'Teyagh'. The waters here have a distinct reddish tint from the iron in the soil, which the villagers mine from riverside outcrops.[1]

name: Gereden
description: Gereden and its outlying hamlets on the southern end of the Devseg Plateau, near the juncture of Ozu River and Teyagh River. Though rough country, it is known for the fine clay that can be gathered from the ravines. [1]

name: Hakkun
description: The village of Hakkun is perched atop the escarpment of the Akkan Hills. The people of these parts have long mined silver from the mountains, a trade that the 4 khans were happy to encourage when they conquered this region. [1]

name: Kiraz
description: Kiraz lies in a basin at the southern end of the Devseg Plateau. Until recently, this land was dominated by nomads, and the people here still make their living by raising sheep. [1]

name: Kaysar
description: Kaysar sits in the north and east of the lands ruled by the 4s, in the valley of the Karakaz river. This district is snowbound for much of the year, but villagers still raise herds of cattle bred to withstand the icy winds coming downriver from the north.

name: Payam
description: Payam lies alongside the Karakaz river in the cold north of the 4 lands. Though the land is snowbound much of the year, the villagers sow wheat and barley as soon as the melt starts, taking in a good crop before the autumn.

name: Omrotok
description: Omrotok sits at the foot of the Sulun Dag mountains, that mark the eastern border of the Devseg plateau. Villagers go to the nearby woods to harvest one of the Devseg's few sources of timber.

name: Simira
description: Simira sits near the east of the Devseg plateau, as it begins to descend into the great grass sea of the east. Villagers here raise cattle bred to withstand both cold winters and hot summers.

name: Kohi Ajik
description: Kohi Ajik lies in a narrow, dry valley at the foot of the so-called Lover's Mountain, from which its name derives. The peoples of this land buy horses from the nomads to their east and sell them to the 4 aristocracy in the towns.

name: Usek
description: Usek sits at the foot of the Akkan hills on the eastern shores of Lake Tanaesis, which the 4 call the Tanaz Sea. The villagers, who until recently were nomads, raise sheep known for their long, fine wool.

name: Esme
description: The village of Esme and its surrounding hamlets lie on the landward side of the Akkan hills on the Devseg plateau, prime grazing lands for the flocks of the 4 and their confederates.

name: Forin
description: Forin       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 6   Fortification Mazhadan Castle    Forin is a village in 6 owned by Grand Prince Raganvad of clan Gundaroving. The village is bound to Mazhadan Castle and known to produce Grain.

name: Mazhadan
description: Mazhadan sits near the source of the Galchas River, just west of Lake Laconis. Villagers grow flax in the muddy valleys between the hills in this cold, rainy land.[1]

name: Dnin
description: Dnin sits on pastures overlooking the narrowest part of the Bay of Varcheg. Horses graze on the heights, glancing down occasionally at the trading longships and fishing boats passing beneath them.[1]

name: Nevyansk
description: Nevyansk sits on a flat shelf of land overlooking the Bay of Varcheg. The land is cold, but the runoff from the hills brings rich soil, and villagers grow hardy crops like rye and barley.[1]

name: Ov
description: Ov is a recent 6n colony in the Ircara wilds, a forest northwest of Lake Laconis. Villagers brave cold, wolves and the sometimes-hostile, sometimes-friendly peoples of the woods in pursuit of fur, the bounty of the northlands.[1]

name: Takor
description: Takor is a cattle raising village at the pass that the 2ns call 'Mynad Rhyfel', the mountain of war, and their imperial and 6n neighbors call Minador. It is one of the main trading and raiding routes between the wild north and the more settled imperial lands.[1]

name: Dvorusta
description: Dvorusta is a fishing village overlooking the rapids linking Mazopor Bay with Lake Laconis. Villagers make their way down the cliffsides at dawn to catch salmon leaping over the rocks, as well as herring and cod in the sea.[1]

name: Urikskala
description: Urikskala sits in the Portages of Iltan, a network of glacial lakes over which longships can be hauled and sailed between Lake Laconis and Lake Tanaesis. Villagers net small spiny perch and crayfish in the shallow waters, drying them for sale to travelers.[1]

name: Alov
description: Alov sits on the edge of the glacial lakes known as the Portages of Iltan. Villagers cultivate rye and barley on the high ground overlooking the lakes, and the rich black soil of the region compensates for the long winters and short growing season.[1]

name: Vladiv
description: Vladiv sits at the base of Mount Iltan, in a cold, dark wooded valley. The hardy cattle of this region have learned to dig through thick winter snows in search of grass to sustain them until the spring.[1]

name: Caleus
description: Caleus lies on the misty coastal plain south of the Bay of Varcheg. Villagers speak a mix of the 7n, 6n and 2n tongues. They grow flax in the lowlands here.[1]

name: Deriat
description: Deriat       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Caleus Castle    Deriat is a village in 7 owned by Baron Servic of House dey Valant. The village is bound to Caleus Castle and known to produce Olives.

name: Drapand
description: Drapand  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Drapand Castle    Drapand is a village in 7 owned by the baron, Aldric of the House dey Tihr. The village is bound to Drapand Castle and is known to produce Olives.

name: Valanby
description: Valanby  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Drapand Castle    Valanby is a village in 7 owned by the baron, Aldric of the House dey Tihr. The village is bound to Drapand Castle and is known to produce Olives. It is likely that the town is famous for its horses and the namesake of the Valanby Courser breed.

name: Hongard
description: Hongard  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Hongard Castle    Hongard is a village in 7 owned by the baron, Vartin of House dey Jelind. The village is bound to Hongard Castle and is known to produce Grain.

name: Ferton
description: Ferton  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Hongard Castle    Ferton is a village in 7 owned by the baron, Vartin of House dey Jelind. The village is bound to Hongard Castle and is known to produce Olives.

name: Ormanfard
description: Ormanfard sits by a small, fast-flowing river that runs down from the mountains of the Rhennod to fill the lake known as Ocspool. Rains are plentiful and wheat and barley grow well on the hillsides.

name: Talivel
description: Talivel       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Talivel Castle    Talivel is a village in 7 owned by King Derthert of House dey Meroc. The village is bound to Talivel Castle and known to produce Olives.

name: Rodetan
description: Rodetan  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Talivel Castle    Rodetan is a village in 7 owned by King Derthert of House dey Meroc. The village is bound to Talivel Castle and is known to produce Iron Ore.

name: Tirby
description: Tirby  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Tirby Castle    Tirby is a village in 7 owned by the baron, Ospir of the House dey Gunric. The village is bound to Tirby Castle and known to produce Silver Ore.

name: Sirindac
description: Sirindac       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Tirby Castle    Sirindac is a village in 7 owned by the baron, Ospir of the House dey Gunric. The village is bound to Tirby Castle and known to produce Flax.

name: Usanc
description: Usanc       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Usanc Castle    Usanc is a village in 7 owned by Baron Berican of House dey Rothad. The village is bound to Usanc Castle and known to produce Olives.

name: Verecsand
description: Verecsand sits by the waters of the Ocspool, a small but deep inland lake. Villagers here grow wheat in the gentle downs by the lakeside.

name: Marin
description: Marin  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom 7   Fortification Verecsand Castle    Marin is a village in 7 owned by the baron, Belgir of the House dey Fortes. The village is bound to Verecsand Castle and is known to produce Grapes.

name: Ataconia
description: Ataconia sits on a plateau in the piedmont of the Dryatic Mountains. The people of this area are skilled at finding seams of silver ore exposed by the streams rushing down from the mountains. [1]

name: Potamis
description: Potamis  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Ataconia Castle    Potamis is a village of the Northern Empire owned by Manteos of the Argoron clan.  The village is bound to Ataconia Castle and is known to produce Cows.

name: Masangara
description: Masangara sits on the banks of the Nevys, a cold, slow-moving river that empties into Lake Laconis. Cattle are raised here in former marshy woodlands, now drained and turned into meadows.[1]

name: Gaos
description: Gaos sits in a broad valley in the Myzead, the hill country in the east of the Empire. Nomadic herders once occupied this land, and the village's name is taken from their word for cattle.[1]

name: Themys
description: Themys lies under a ridge of limestone crags in the Myzead, the hill country of the imperial heartland. The grasses on the rolling downs are well-suited to the raising of sheep.[1]

name: Epinosa
description: Epinosa  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Epinosa Castle    Epinosa is a village of the Northern Empire owned by Tasynor of the Phalentes clan. The village is bound to Epinosa Castle and known to produce Cows.

name: Pons
description: Pons  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Epinosa Castle    Pons is a village of the Northern Empire owned by Tasynor of the Phalentes clan. The village is bound to Epinosa Castle and known to produce Cows.

name: Lochana
description: Lochana sits on the eastern shore of Lake Laconis. The muddy, low-lying land here is well suited to the growing of flax.[1]

name: Nortanisa
description: Nortansia  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Lochana Castle    Nortansia is a village of the Northern Empire owned by Nicasor of the Chonis clan. The village is bound to Lochana Castle and known to produce Fish.

name: Agalmon
description: Agalmon sits near the juncture of the Galchas River and the Miron River, two small but fast-flowing northern rivers. This foresting village has had mostly good relations with its 6n neighbors thanks to decades of intermarriage, though they have become strained of late with the outbreak of war.[1]

name: Mecalovea
description: Mecalovea sits overlooking the Galchasic Cataracts, a series of rapids and waterfalls through which the Miron River empties into Lake Laconis. The village, perched on a cliffside for protection from raiders in this frontier region, thrives on the ore deposits exposed where the cataract cuts through the escarpment.[1]

name: Rhesos
description: Rhesos sits in a plateau in the Dryatic Mountains. Highland cattle thrive on the grasses of the heights.[1]

name: Dyopalis
description: Dyopalis lies in a valley in the Dryatic Mountains. Despite the cold winters, the region's fertile soils make this district one of the breadbaskets of the northern Empire.[1]

name: Syratos
description: Syratos       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Syratos Castle    Syratos is a village of the Northern Empire owned by Archon Maritzios of clan Vatatzes. The village is bound to Syratos Castle and known to produce Iron Ore.

name: Tememos
description: Tememos       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Syratos Castle    Tememos is a village in the Northern Empire owned by Archon Maritzios of clan Vatatzes. The village is bound to Syratos Castle and known to produce Hardwood.

name: Aeoria
description: Aeoria  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Northern Empire   Fortification Varagos Castle    Aeoria is a village of the Northern Empire owned by the archon Penton of the Neretzes clan. The village is bound to Varagos Castle and it is known to produce Grain.

name: Varagos
description: Varagos sits on the Aris River, a small highland stream that flows into the deep pool known as the Ophthys. The land here is not especially rich, but is sufficient for the raising of sheep.[1]

name: Chanopsis
description: Chanopsis sits near the headwaters of the Sethys River in the plateau region known as the Myzead. Wheat grows well on the sun-baked plains.[1]

name: Popsia
description: Popsia is located in a narrow canyon between the Ornian Rock and the valley of the Ophthys pool. Trees grow tall here in the cool shadows of the hills, and villagers harvest pines for sale as lumber.[1]

name: Corenia
description: Corenia is one of the farthest flung villages of the Empire to speak the Calradic tongue. It sits in the plains southeast of Lake Tanaesis in the shadow of the Akkan Hills, beyond which is spoken only Darshi and the languages of the steppe. Villagers grow grain here, keeping watch for raiders from across the frontiers.[1]

name: Metachia
description: Metachia is the lies on the southern shores of Lake Tanaesis in the frontier lands beyond River Tiagys. This imperial colony, established in more peaceful times, is a center for mulberry bushes used in silk production.[1]

name: Jogurys
description: Jogurys lies on the flat western shores of Lake Tanaesis. This land was originally inhabited by nomadic tribes and has come under cultivation only recently. Imperial colonists have made intensive efforts to grow mullberry bushes here to raise silkworms, a lucrative product in this region.[1]

name: Eunalica
description: Eunalica sits on the western shores of Lake Tanaesis. This low-lying country is fine land for the growing of flax.[1]

name: Ethemisa
description: Ethemisa sits on the river that the 1 call the Nahr al-Kals, the Bitter River, and what imperial citizens call the Calsa River. Here, the river has just descended from the coastal hills and has not yet reached the alkali plains of the southeast. The lands around produce a fine crop of grain.  [1]

name: Lavenia
description: Lavenia is a fishing village on the northeastern shores of the Perassic Sea. The nearby castle guards one of the main passages over the network of lakes and salt lagoons known as the Calsea, one of the gateways to 1 lands. [1]

name: Melion
description: Melion in a narrow valley near the center of the Myzead, a rugged plateau in the east of the Empire. Villagers here cultivate mulberry bushes. The leaves are harvested and fed to silkworks, producing thread much valued by both refined imperial nobles for their courtwear and hard-riding nomads and frontiersmen, who wear it beneath their armor as an extra layer of protection against arrows. [1]

name: Sagolina
description: Sagolina sits at the foot of a narrow valley in the Myzead, a rugged plateau in eastern Calradia. The silver mined from nearby hills helps explain the effort and expense to which the Empire has gone in past centuries to conquer and defend these lands. [1]

name: Atphynia
description: The village of Atphynia sits near the mouth of the Sethys River, just before it splits into three to form the valley known as Tripotamia. Villagers here have laid out salt pans near where the Sethys estuary joins the Perassic Sea.[1]

name: Morenia
description: Morenia sits overlooking the Sethys River, on a low pass leading over the hills to the Lycarea Valley. Villagers collect clay from the riverbanks for the kilns of the imperial southlands.  [1]

name: Odrysa
description: Odrysa lies on the far eastern frontiers of the Empire, just across the River Tiagys from lands that are now the 4 Khanate. Though this area is dry, oak and other trees grow in the Tiagys gorges and other nooks in the hills, sustaining a small lumber industry.[1]

name: Caira
description: Caira sits amid the network of rivers, lakes and lagoons known as the Calsea. Any further east, the land becomes alkaline and barren, but here the floodplains of the parallel Calsa River and Tiagys River allow the growing of wheat.[1]

name: Amycon
description: Amycon lies in a series of small but sharp ridges between the Ornian Rock and the Aris Valley. The people of this land are sheep herders, known for their dry, salty cheese flavored with cumin.[1]

name: Sestadaim
description: Sestadaim sits on the western side of the great Ornian Rock, an outcrop in the center of the Lycarea Valley. Some say the vultures for which the rock is named once gathered here to feast on the bodies of those who died working the local silver mines.[1]

name: Garontor
description: Garontor gives its name to the promontory between the Gulf of Charas and the inland Perassic Sea. Coastal meadows, where tall grasses tolerant of the ocean salt-spray thrive, support the rearing of fine horses.

name: Lysia
description: Lysia  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Western Empire    Lysia is a village of the Western Empire owned by Apys of the Varros clan. The village is bound to Garontor Castle and it is known to produce Salt.

name: Gersegos
description: Gersegos sits in the gorges of the Miron river, as it cuts between the cliffs of the Cursion Escarpment and the Dryatic mountains. Villagers have sunk mines into a spur that overlooks the village, extracting silver and other precious metals.[1]

name: Vathea
description: Vathea sits high on the slopes of the Dryatic mountains, facing across the valley to the great basalt slab of Mount Erithrys. The villagers mine iron from shafts sunk deep into the cliffs of the mountains.[1]

name: Hertogea
description: Hertogea  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Western Empire    Hertogea is a village of Western Empire owned by Vipon of the Maneolis clan. The village is bound to Hertogea Castle and known for the production of Iron Ore.

name: Nideon
description: Nideon  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Western Empire    Nideon is a village of Western Empire owned by by Vipon of the Maneolis clan. The village is bound to Hertogea Castle and known for the production of Olives.

name: Onica
description: Onica  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Western Empire   Fortification Onica Castle    Onica is a village in the Western Empire owned by Emperor Garios of clan Comnos. The village is bound to Onica Castle and known to produce Olives.

name: Tarcutis
description: Tarcutis  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Western Empire   Fortification Onica Castle    Tarcutis is a village in the Western Empire owned by Emperor Garios of clan Comnos. The village is bound to Onica Castle and is known to produce Grapes.

name: Oristocorys
description: Oristocorys       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Western Empire   Fortification Oristocorys Castle    Oristocorys is a village in the Western Empire owned by Archon Vincantios of clan Palladios. The village is bound to Oristocorys Castle and known to produce Furs.

name: Elvania
description: Elvania       Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Western Empire   Fortification Oristocorys Castle    Elvania is a village in the Western Empire owned by Archon Vincantios of clan Palladios. The village is bound to Oristocorys Castle and known to produce Furs.

name: Thorios
description: Thorios sits in the Aris valley in the heart of Calradia. River irrigation and the relatively warm inland climate ensure that the grain fields of this district, along with neighboring Bergum, feed much of the central Empire.[1]

name: Bergum
description: Bergum sits in the Aris valley in the heart of Calradia. River irrigation and the relatively warm inland climate ensure that the grain fields of this district, along with neighboring Thorios, feed much of the central Empire.[1]

name: Thractorae
description: Thractorae sits on a small bay that feeds into the larger Gulf of Charas. These lands, stirred by hot winds from the south and watered by hillside springs, have been used by imperial landowners for the experimental growing of date palms.

name: Gamardan
description: Gamardan sits at the head of a small bay that branches off the larger Gulf of Charas. The wines of this region are unusually sweet and strong, and valued throughout the Empire.

name: Goleryn
description: Goleryn  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Western Empire   Fortification Veron Castle    Goleryn is a village of Western Empire owned by by Achios of the Corenios. The village is bound to Veron Castle and it is know for the production of Sheep.

name: Veron
description: Veron  Settlement Information  Type Village   Kingdom Western Empire   Fortification Veron Castle    Veron is a village of the Western Empire owned by Achios of the Corenios. The village is bound to Veron Castle and it is know for the production of Sheep.
